newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Copel started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Copel started as buy.

text.p: -- HSBC James Capel said it started coverage of Brazilian power generator Copel with a rating of buy.
-- "Copel's competitive edge is its low cost of energy generation, which should be the lever for growth in future years," analyst Luciana Portolano wrote in a Monday report.
-- "In the free-market, deregulated environment that is evolving in the Brazilian electric utility sector, we believe Copel will be a key player both inside and outside its concession area."
-- She added, "Our one-year price target for Copel voting shares is $17.30, implying a potential appreciation of 73 percent from current levels."
-- The company's shares were up 0.03 to 10.80 in Sao Paulo.
